name: Secret Communication
label: Quest
description: Secret Communication: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. I want you to bring me a stack of them, adventurer.

I can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point! These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly. The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me some texts?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I'll stash these away, maybe they'll be useful later.
